Its substance is practical and entertainment-focused: it explains the game's visual style and development, then clarifies an in-game power-weapon ammunition mechanic. The studio setting and Destiny-themed materials reinforce that this is an informational discussion of a video game, while the reference to future features is qualified rather than framed as a promise of financial returns.
